history.value: The one-turn net's cost on an unseen turn-start power on a new enemy splits by where the power's payoff lies. Inside the search horizon (SharpHide: damage reflected on this turn's attacks) it is both a horizon and a training gap: two-turn search repairs it (novelty +0.005 to -0.014 at 200 x 4) and so does fine-tuning on about 100 games against it (cut 1.17x at 99 games, 1.65x at 1602, retention within 0.6 se). Past the horizon (Ritual 2: Strength growing every turn, costing most on bosses) neither repairs it: two turns deep -0.036 (0.012), 1602 games cut only 0.38x. Turn-start powers on cards (the swap cost 0.260 one turn -> 0.120 two turns) stay a horizon reading. What would repair a past-horizon payoff is an input the net can read (the net half of new-mechanics-workflow), not depth on the dev machine (cause/depth-saturated) and not more games.

history.value: The one-turn net's cost on changed enemies (the key's name is historical: only the elite half is a horizon reading). Elites, powers that punish attacking (SharpHide, Thorns, WeakOnHit): a cost inside the search horizon (sharp2 -0.082 and thorns2 -0.075 win, +5.5 HP lost beyond the heuristic), repaired by two-turn search (+0.085, +0.076) and by about 100 games against SharpHide (measurement/adaptation-curve), the repair carrying to Thorns and WeakOnHit, which it never trained on (measurement/adaptation-transfer). Bosses: the cost follows the boss's shifted numbers, not growth past the horizon. By the start-stratified odds ratio against the heuristic (parent edge +0.42 (0.27) one turn deep, +0.97 (0.24) two turns) a static +2 Strength is -0.64 (0.24) below the parent and Ritual 2 -0.82 (0.31) one turn deep, -0.53 (0.30) and -0.73 (0.38) two turns deep, hp0.8 -0.61 (0.32) and -0.84 (0.47), while sharp2 and thorns2 cost nothing there; depth, 1602 games against Ritual 2 (cut 0.38x) and the rate columns (measurement/rate-columns@ritual2) do not repair it. 66 boss starts, 2-3 se: a lead; part of the win-rate column on bosses is the scale (yardstick/novelty-read). Specific to growth: only ritual2 on elites, +2.42 (0.52) HP lost against +0.41 (0.18) for str2. Not separated yet: a new mechanic from a fight more dangerous than training's range (SharpHide, seen on the Guardian, costs as much on elites as unseen Thorns; the net is below the heuristic on every contested elite variant). Exits (lane difficulty-shift): the wide boss read shows no odds-ratio cost, then the boss half was the scale; or a burst on plain stat changes repairs the reactive powers, then the unit of novelty is danger, not the mechanic.
